entry.title: Redirects for AI Training enforces canonical content
entry.summary: Soft directives don’t stop crawlers from ingesting deprecated content. Redirects for AI Training allows anybody on Cloudflare to redirect verified crawlers to canonical pages with one toggle and no origin changes.

entry.title: Unweight: how we compressed an LLM 22% without sacrificing quality
entry.summary: Running LLMs across Cloudflare’s network requires us to be smarter and more efficient about GPU memory bandwidth. That’s why we developed Unweight, a lossless inference-time compression system that achieves up to a 22% model footprint reduction, so that we can deliver faster and cheaper inference than ever before.

entry.title: Agents that remember: introducing Agent Memory

entry.title: Agents Week: network performance update
entry.summary: By migrating our request handling layer to a Rust-based architecture called FL2, Cloudflare has increased its performance lead to 60% of the world’s top networks. We use real-user measurements and connection trimeans to ensure our data reflects the actual experience of people on the Internet.

entry.title: Introducing Flagship: feature flags built for the age of AI
